Run `fastfetch` in a terminal to view device information, including your iOS version, uptime, memory, and storage.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS 15 or later and a roothide or rootless bootstrap. Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide or `iphoneos-arm64` for rootless.
